description: Change an X custom audience: rename / redescribe it, and/or ADD or REMOVE people (operation add|remove) — same identifiers as create_x_ads_audience, hashed on our server. X reports how many it processed and Hermoso relays it; a mismatch is flagged as not fully applied. Read back. Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

audienceId.description: custom audience id to change, from list_x_ads_audiences

effectiveAt.description: ISO 8601 time the membership change takes effect (sent to X as effective_at)

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the members expire; must be later than effectiveAt

operation.description: add or remove: whether the people in this call are added to or removed from the audience

twitterIds.description: X user ids to add; hashed on Hermoso's server before X receives them

users.description: one person per entry with several identifiers: {email, phone, handle, twitterId, deviceId}

name: update_x_ads_audience
title: Change an X custom audience
